name: Mars Perps
rootCause: Mars Perps on Neutron was reported exploited on 2025-12-14 after a same-block funding rate arbitrage loop drained value from the shared lending pool. Public summaries place the loss at about $960K, and later forensic tracing followed $973,079.89 in USDC through the exit path. Mars Perps let execution price move with open-interest skew while funding did not accrue within the same block. That allowed a looped short position sequence to extract value without paying the intended carrying cost, and the resulting shortfall flowed into the linked lending pool.
